selection.name: C01 — attest
selection.role: Bind published artifacts and SBOMs to signed workflow provenance. Selected for public GitHub repositories; supplies artifact attribution, not check-log recovery or repair.
selection.install_command:
permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write
  attestations: write
steps:
  - uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6 # v4.2.2
    with:
      subject-path: '<PATH TO BUILT ARTIFACT>'
selection.install_source: https://github.com/actions/attest/blob/main/README.md — documented workflow installation; immutable v4.2.2 reference corroborated by https://github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor/blob/7edf1f06b3da7b9093f85b583014a9f9036dc496/.github/workflows/release-binaries.yml.

basis.shows: Signed provenance and SBOM attestations with artifact digests, repository association and verification through GitHub CLI. Public repositories are supported on all current plans; private/internal use requires Enterprise Cloud.
Linux-hosted tests demonstrate job-scoped permissions, locked npm installation and an actual attestation invocation.
TypeScript tests and the hosted attest-action test both completed successfully.
Latest release published 2026-08-04, within 90 days.
Latest default-branch commit dated 2026-09-24.
Issue opened and closed on 2026-09-17.

layers.deciding_comparison: The set is provisional on capability fit, not measured superiority. On WSL2 x86_64, compare Syft and Trivy against the same digest-pinned images and installed filesystem, measuring package/version recall, false inventory entries, determinism, scan time and memory; repeat installation on macOS arm64. Compare zizmor plus kjanat/actionlint against poutine on identical labelled Actions fixtures, measuring permission/pinning/injection coverage and false positives. When a real Actions check fails, qualify an upstream CI-repair skill separately: recover the correct run/job logs, preserve check attribution, make a minimal repair and obtain a passing rerun. No packet comparison establishes that repair outcome.
evidence_gaps: Exactly 30 GitHub API calls were used, including two GraphQL calls for source, release, issue and check data; no web searches were used. All candidate archive flags and default-branch dates were checked. The 90-day cutoff is 2026-07-03.
No target-host head-to-head was supplied or executed. Upstream suites and successful checks establish verification practices, not comparative accuracy or speed.

The selected set does not establish reproducible build hashes, complete application dependency locking, live-process inventory, or CI-repair competence. Syft inventories filesystems/artifacts; scan the actual installed runtime or final artifact rather than only source manifests.

Linux binaries and upstream Linux tests support expected WSL2 compatibility, but WSL2 execution was not measured. The local CLI selections have macOS arm64 release support; attest was verified on hosted Linux. No selected role requires the RTX 4090.

Agent-callable CLIs are documented, but end-to-end Claude Code/Codex execution was not tested. Poutine explicitly documents MCP integration. Lower-fit candidates were not exhaustively qualified for installation and platform behavior.

Version substitutions in installation commands follow documented installation patterns. Syft's bootstrap URL remains mutable. The attest release SHA was corroborated by published upstream usage rather than a separate tag-dereference API call.
